conclusions: The thirteen HTTP errors are bound to exact requested URLs, not a proven publisher/WAF/paywall/proxy diagnosis. Their original responses did not retain enough denial metadata to distinguish those causes.
The Sysdig citation guard rejects an unapproved host, but its exact target/stage is absent; the initial URL itself is in the allowed host list. The generic charged ContractError remains unclassified.
No endpoint or allowlist defect is established by the retained evidence. New guessed routes, aliases, credentials or access bypass are not supported.
Older retained successful bytes keep their original clocks and cannot replace a newer failed forced check or grant current intake credit.
The old H task identifiers are historical. A real J run has its own identifiers; all fourteen relevant source rows are unchanged by J.
